# healthcare-policy

> OPAL-tracked policy mirror for Cloud Healthcare Exchange. Not a standalone product.

Do not edit Rego here. Canonical source and OPA tests live in `policy/` on
[Healthcare-Data-Exchange](https://github.com/SafetyMP/Healthcare-Data-Exchange).
Clone that repo to change policy, then run `./scripts/sync-policy-repo.sh`.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): community contract (do not edit Rego, canonical repo, verify)
- [README.md](README.md): mirror role and sync workflow
- [docs/DESIGN-PIVOT.md](docs/DESIGN-PIVOT.md): remain a mirror; never a second HIE
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): PRs that edit `authz.rego` are rejected
- [Copilot instructions](.github/copilot-instructions.md): never-do rules

## Verify

- `./scripts/verify.sh`
